title: Automatic retry for failed fulfillment-webhook deliveries
description:
Context: The warehouse fulfillment service consumes order events via a webhook; when it is down, deliveries fail and orders sit unfulfilled until manual replay (ops ran 14 manual replays last quarter, ~3h each). Webhook payloads are already idempotent on the consumer side (event-id deduplication verified by the platform team).
Scope: This story adds automatic redelivery for failed webhook deliveries. Out of scope: webhook payload changes, new consumer endpoints.
roadmap_context: Grow revenue and conversion by expanding the checkout to modern payment methods and making payment flows reliable. Roadmap context: Q3-Q4 growth initiative; business goal is +8% checkout conversion and reduced payment-failure support tickets. Success is measured via checkout funnel analytics and the payments incident rate.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Retry policy agreed with the platform team: 5 attempts, exponential backoff 1/5/15/60/300s, total window under 7 minutes.

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: Idempotency: redeliveries reuse the same delivery id; the consumer's event-id dedup makes replays safe (already verified).

comments.author: Story Author
comments.text: DLQ threshold: move to dead-letter after attempt 5; dashboard: new 'webhook redeliveries' counter on the existing integrations board.
